|lore=Loyal Wookiee companion of Captain Han Solo. Co-pilot of the ''Millennium Falcon''. Leia referred to him as a “walking carpet.”
|game_text=Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots (4 if ''Falcon''). While piloting ''Falcon'', it is maneuver +2, Chewie draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise, and your battle destiny draws (and total battle destiny) at same system may not be modified, canceled, or reset by opponent.

|notes=The [[Chewie (V) (Virtual Set 10: Fourth Anthology) (Original 2005)|2005 original wording]] survives in the recovered publisher sheet. Falcon retains its maneuver bonus, the fallback destiny draw and the protection against opponent modification, cancellation or reset of destiny draws and total at the same system.
